_help: Reusable environment profile for `kuru init --profile <thisfile>`. Copy it OUTSIDE the plugin (e.g. ~/.kuru/profiles/gradle-kube.json) and edit for your org. The profile is GUIDANCE, not gospel: 'stack' seeds the initial gate preset at init; 'config' and 'environment' are read by /kuru:charter, which summarizes them back to you, fills any gaps, then writes the authoritative .kuru/config.json and folds the rest into the charter. Nothing here is secret-by-design — internal URLs are fine, but gitignore the profile if you prefer.

config._help: OPTIONAL. Omit to just use the 'stack' preset. If present, /kuru:charter uses these gate commands as the STARTING POINT when it writes config.json (it confirms/tailors them with you first — they are not applied verbatim). Air-gapped example: gradle --offline against a populated cache.

airgap.notes: no internet during build; init.gradle points at the mirror; gradle runs --offline
